newsitem.title: CANADA: Bell, NTN in interactive alliance.
newsitem.headline: Bell, NTN in interactive alliance.

text.p: Bell Canada said on Monday it has formed an alliance with NTN Communications Inc to develop interactive programming for the Canadian market.
The alliance also includes NTN Communications' Canadian licensee, NTN Canada Inc. Bell Canada is a unit of BCE Inc.

Bell said the mulit-million dollar contract calls for NTN to help develop content for trivia games, play along sporting events, entertainment, and polling. NTN will also help develop a user interface for the product.
Financial details of the contract were not disclosed.
A company spokesman said the new services were expected to be available early next year.
The service will be delivered over the company's phone lines, which are being upgraded using a variety of technologies including fiber optics and high-speed modems and swtiches.
The spokesman said the consumer could access the service through a computer or from his television.

Canada's television and telephone markets are being deregulated and development of interactive programming has been seen as one of the first steps in bringing telecommunication companies up against traditional broadcasters and cable companies, which are also planning interactive products.
Bell said the alliance gives the company access to NTN's library of interactive content and will allow it to develop programs designed for the Canadian marketplace.
